name: AWR Top Events 分析诊断
description: AWR Top 5/10 Timed Events 是性能分析最重要的入口。按 DB Time 占比排序显示等待事件和 CPU Time。分析方法：先看 DB Time 分解（CPU vs Wait），再按 wait_class 分类（User I/O/Concurrency/Application/Configuration 等），最后深入具体事件。

conditions.desc: 单个等待事件占 DB Time > 30%

skip_when.desc: db file sequential read 在 OLTP 中占比高是正常的
skip_when.condition: top_event = 'db file sequential read' AND pct < 40 AND avg_wait_ms < 5

root_causes.name: I/O 等待主导（db file sequential/scattered read）
root_causes.desc: 物理 I/O 等待占 DB Time 大比例。可能存储慢、缓存不足、或 SQL 效率低。

root_causes.name: 锁等待主导（enq: TX/TM）
root_causes.desc: 应用级锁争用。行锁、表锁、或 DDL 与 DML 冲突。

root_causes.name: CPU 瓶颈（DB CPU 占比高）
root_causes.desc: DB CPU 占 DB Time 大部分且 CPU 利用率高。可能 SQL 低效或并发过高。

root_causes.name: 内部争用（latch/mutex/log file sync）
root_causes.desc: Oracle 内部资源争用。latch free、cursor: pin S、log file sync 等。

root_causes.name: 网络等待（SQL*Net message from/to client）
root_causes.desc: 前台等待通常与应用的 fetch 行为有关（过多 roundtrip）。

oltp.desc: db file sequential read avg < 5ms 正常

olap.desc: db file scattered read 占比高是正常的

step1_top_events.sql: SELECT event_name, wait_class, total_waits, ROUND(time_waited_micro/1e6, 2) time_waited_sec, ROUND(time_waited_micro/GREATEST(total_waits,1)/1000, 2) avg_wait_ms FROM v$system_event WHERE wait_class != 'Idle' ORDER BY time_waited_micro DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

step2_db_time_breakdown.sql: SELECT 'DB CPU' metric, ROUND(value/100, 2) seconds FROM v$sys_time_model WHERE stat_name = 'DB CPU' UNION ALL SELECT 'DB Time', ROUND(value/100, 2) FROM v$sys_time_model WHERE stat_name = 'DB time'

step3_wait_class_summary.sql: SELECT wait_class, SUM(total_waits) total_waits, ROUND(SUM(time_waited_micro)/1e6, 2) time_waited_sec FROM v$system_event WHERE wait_class != 'Idle' GROUP BY wait_class ORDER BY time_waited_sec DESC

step4_event_histogram.sql: SELECT event, wait_time_milli, wait_count FROM v$event_histogram WHERE event = '&event_name' ORDER BY wait_time_milli
